paite: TOUPA athupi a, nakpitak a phat ding ahi, i Pathian khopi ah, atang siangthou ah.
heading: Korah Tate La / Pathian Khopi Zion
english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

paite: Asandan a kilawm, leitung tengteng kipahna, Zion tang ahi, mallam pang a, Kumpipa thupitak khopi.
english: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

paite: A-inpi ah Pathian in insang ahihdan akitheisak hi.
english: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

paite: Ngai in, kumpipate akikhawm ua, apaikhawmta uhi.
english: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

paite: Amu ua, huchi in lamdang asa ua; amangbang ua, apaimang pah uhi.
english: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

paite: Huai ah linna in aman a; numei nauvei natna in amat lai bang in.
english: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

paite: Suahlam huih in Tarshish long liante ana hihse zel hi.
english: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA khopi ah, i Pathian khopi ah, bil a i zak bangtak in i muta; Pathian in huai khopi tangtawn a ding in ahihkip ding. Selah
english: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

paite: Pathian aw, na tempul sunggil ah na zahngaihna ka ngaihtuahta uhi.
english: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.

paite: Pathian aw, na min bang ngei in na phatna kawlmong pha in a-om a; na khut taklam diktatna in adim hi.
english: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

paite: Na vaihawmnate ziak in Zion tang kipaktak in om henla, Judah tanute nuam in om uhen.
english: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

paite: Zion kim ah, akimvel in pai unla; agalven insangte leng sim un.
english: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

paite: Akulhte chiamteh hoih unla, a-inpite ngaihtuah un; khang hong om nawnte a na hilhtheihna ding un.
english: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

paite: Hiai Pathian tangtawn tangtawn a i Pathian hi ding ahi a, sih tanpha a leng hon pipa ahi ding hi.
english: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
